h2. Data flow

h3. What this is (one sentence)

*PagerDuty holds the incident. Slack/Teams is the window. PagerDuty AI is the helper that answers inside that window.*

h3. Setup (wire once)

{code}
PagerDuty (license OK — /ai works)
  → Step 1: Connect Slack workspace and/or Teams app
  → Step 2: AI Settings → Chat Integrations = Connected + On
  → Enable agents (Scribe / Triage / …)
  → Each SRE: Link Account (PD user ↔ chat user)
  → Test channel: /pd connect (or Teams equivalent)
{code}

||Step||Who||Done when||
|0 License|PD admin|/ai and AI Settings usable|
|1 Chat app|PD + Slack/M365 admin|/pd works (Slack) or PD bot works (Teams)|
|2 AI On|PD admin|Chat Integrations Connected + On; agents Enabled|
|3 Link user|Each SRE|You can run AI commands as yourself|
|4 Channel|SRE|/pd connect (or Teams) on a test channel|

h3. Runtime (every incident)

{code}
Something breaks
  → Incident created/updated in PagerDuty
  → PD posts into connected Slack and/or Teams channel
  → You ask in chat: @PagerDuty Catch me up  |  /pd scribe  |  root-cause questions
  → PagerDuty AI reads incident (+ allowed chat context)
  → Answer appears in the same channel
  → You fact-check → ack / escalate / resolve in PagerDuty
{code}

h3. Who talks to whom

{code}
Dynatrace / other tools  --create/update-->  PagerDuty incident
PagerDuty                --notify-------->  Slack  and/or  Teams
Human in chat            --ask----------->  @PagerDuty / /pd …
PagerDuty AI             --answer-------->  same chat
Human                    --act----------->  PagerDuty (ack, assign, resolve)
{code}

{info}
This is *not* the Dynatrace Hub Slack Connection or an Incoming Webhook used by Dynatrace workflows. Those are a different path.
{info}

h3. Chat Integrations status

||Status||Meaning||Next action||
|Not Connected|Chat app not finished|Finish Step 1 (Slack Allow / Teams install)|
|Update required / optional permissions|Need AI scopes|Approve scopes|
|Connected + Off|App linked, AI off|Turn chat On in AI Settings|
|Connected + On|Ready|Link users + connect test channel|
